Revised specification is ready for review at the **spec gate** — still no planning or code. `specs/001-bookmark-manager/spec.md`.

## What changed, mapped to your requests

Every item you raised is now in the spec:

| Your request | Where it lives now |
|---|---|
| Single-user, no login | Confirmed — Assumptions |
| Import + export in the usual bookmark-file format | **US5**, FR-021 / FR-022, SC-005 / SC-006 |
| Capture title, description, icon, preview; edit before/after saving | **US1**, FR-002 / FR-003 |
| Saving same address → open existing for editing | US4 scenario 2, FR-015 |
| Edit the address itself | FR-003 |
| Existing tags suggested while typing | US3 scenario 1, FR-012 |
| Search: descriptions + notes, case-insensitive, `#tag`, quoted phrases, AND/OR/NOT/parentheses | US2 scenarios 3–4, FR-008 / FR-009 |
| Sorting options, not only newest-first | FR-007 |
| Separate read-later and archive states, each its own view; archive reversible, distinct from deletion | **US6**, FR-016 / FR-017 / FR-018 |
| Bulk select (incl. all filtered results): tag, read/unread, archive, delete | **US7**, FR-019 / FR-020 |
| Reusable saved views from search + included/excluded tags | **US8**, FR-014 |
| Notes with simple formatting, rendered when viewed | **US10**, FR-026 |
| Local copy (PDFs kept as PDFs) + optional Internet Archive snapshot | **US9**, FR-023 / FR-024 / FR-025 |
| List shows title, description, tags, icon; display prefs (default sort, density, text size) | **US11**, FR-027 / FR-028 |
| Folders not needed | Excluded — Assumptions; tags + saved views replace them |

**Priorities:** US1–US2 stay the P1 MVP (rich save + browse/search/sort). Import/export, states, and bulk actions are P2; saved views, page preservation, formatted notes, and display prefs are P3 — so we can build in value order.

## A few points worth your explicit confirmation before I lock the spec

1. **Internet Archive & page fetching are external/network-dependent.** Metadata fetch, local copies, and IA snapshots are specified as **best-effort** — they fail gracefully without harming the bookmark. Login-gated or highly dynamic pages may not capture faithfully. OK as a boundary?
2. **Local copy fidelity.** I've scoped a local copy as the page's *readable content* (plus PDFs preserved as PDFs), not a pixel-perfect archive of every interactive page. Is that the right expectation, or do you need full-fidelity capture?
3. **Import tag mapping.** On import I map source browser *folders → tags* (since we're dropping folders). Good?
4. **Search operator precedence** (e.g. how AND/OR bind without parentheses) — fine to settle the exact rules at the planning stage, or do you want them pinned in the spec now?

If this reads right, say **approved** and I'll move to the **plan** gate (`speckit-plan`). If anything's off, I'll revise the spec rather than carry it into planning.
